body.name: unit-permutation-then-label-permutation Doob martingale
body.construction: Reveal \(\mathbf U_n^{\mathrm{perm}}\) through time \(N_n\), then \(\mathbf L_n^{\mathrm{perm}}\) through time \(N_n+G_n\); form \(D_{n,r}\) from conditional expectations of \(\widehat\tau_n-\tau_n\) and set \(Q_n=\sum_r\mathbb E[D_{n,r}^2\mid\mathcal F_{n,r-1}]\).
